comments.body:
Added a model-version gate on top of the forwarding fix (c1d3248b).

Gemini 3 and later pick their own sampling values. Google's docs say a custom `temperature`/`topP` is no longer recommended for any Gemini 3.x model, and that Gemini 3.6+ and Gemini 4 ignore custom values for now and will return `400` for them in a future release. Most clients send `temperature`, so forwarding it for every model would turn into request failures on the newest models.

With the gate, the OpenAI-style override applies to models before Gemini 3, and a native `generationConfig` is passed through untouched on every model. The tests now also cover the precedence, the per-model behavior and the Claude-format path, which goes through the same builder.

- https://aistudio.google.com/docs/troubleshooting
- https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/migrate
- https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/capabilities/content-generation-parameters
